mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 1200 and 470000 respectively indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST>1200 and RSAFS>470000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 16000 billion reflects robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 16000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 245 signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 146000 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5 indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS>146000 and UNRATE<4.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 signals weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and the economy is in an early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
